cases.title: Stopped back-top
cases.setup: Mark1 · Black Fiberon PET-GF15 · Glued Engineering Plate · Left hardened 0.4 mm nozzle
cases.alt: Loose black strands hang from the flow-meter ledge. A fallen support fork lies on the printed floor beside the ASSE receiver.
cases.quote: I couldn't even see where the support is under some of that, though, at all. It looks like we're missing supports in some critical places.

landmarks.label: Flow-meter ledge
landmarks.observation: The fore fork came down before the ledge printed. Loose strands hang below the meter seat. The narrow strip beside its hook pocket was changed to grow out of the flank.
landmarks.changeLabel: See the strip grow from the wall

landmarks.label: ASSE catch
landmarks.observation: The long bridge sagged into the insertion opening. A screwdriver can reach the west catch to peel support away. The east catch faces the Pisco, so its roof was sloped to print from the wall.
landmarks.changeLabel: See the reachable and enclosed catches

cases.title: Assembled rear corner
cases.guideTitle: The roof is the first layer
cases.setup: Mark2 · Black Fiberon PET-GF15 · Textured PEI · Left hardened 0.4 mm nozzle
cases.alt: The black printed corner held at the bench with the white flow meter above the Pisco fitting and the ASSE on the right. All three snap covers are in place.

landmarks.label: Pisco seat
landmarks.observation: The Pisco cover could tip past the meter shoulder and seat with the hardware installed. When Derek rocked the covers by hand, the Pisco had the most play.
landmarks.changeLabel: See the change that opened the entry

landmarks.label: Flow-meter seat
landmarks.observation: The meter cover seated with the Pisco installed. Derek found its fit tighter than the Pisco and looser than the ASSE. The shortened meter shoulder leaves the adjacent cover room to swing in.

landmarks.label: ASSE seat
landmarks.observation: The ASSE cover had the tightest fit of the three. Derek judged it good enough on this printed corner.

cases.title: Two-diamond Pisco cover
cases.setup: Mark2 · Black Fiberon PET-GF15 · Textured PEI · Left hardened 0.4 mm nozzle
cases.alt: The white Pisco collet sits above the black cover while Derek presses its lower edge inside the enclosure.
cases.quote: If you made me pick one of these, I would pick two-diamond.

landmarks.label: Pisco cover in its receiver
landmarks.observation: The cover rocks gradually, with slightly less movement than the original. Derek preferred this fit. He found the one-diamond sample hard to distinguish from the original.

cases.title: Three-diamond Pisco cover
cases.setup: Mark1 · Black Fiberon PET-GF15 · Textured PEI · Left hardened 0.4 mm nozzle
cases.alt: Derek holds the corner at an angle and rocks the black cover beneath the white Pisco collet.
cases.quote: three-diamond is the only one that exhibits different behavior, shifting from one firm position to another.

landmarks.label: Pisco cover in its receiver
landmarks.observation: The cover snaps between two firm resting positions. The retaining surfaces on the wings are hidden inside the receiver.
